[[Mörkhalla]] | usage = Crafting }} }} The '''Nord Shield''' is an [[Deep North]]-tier round [[Shields]]. The Nord Shield has less block power compared to the [[Nord Greatshield]] but can be used to [[parry]] enemy attacks. It has more block power compared to the [[Nord Buckler]] but with a smaller parry bonus. It cannot be crafted directly, instead the player must craft the corresponding [[Cast Nord Shield]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. ==Mould== '''Mould: Nord Shield''' can be found: * By destroying trash piles in [[Winding Tunnels]]. * In chests buried at [[Memorial Site]]s. * By destroying weapon stands on the last floor of [[Mörkhalla]]. == Upgrading == {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !Total |- !Blocking armor |132 |138 |144 | |- !Durability |400 |450 |500 | |- !Crafting | [[Bloodgold]] x15
